STEP 5. Check the signal voltage at auto-cruise control-
ECU connector C-20 by backprobing.
(1) Do not disconnect connector C-20.
(2) Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position.
(3) Measure the voltage between terminal 3 and ground by 
backprobing.
• Voltage should be battery positive voltage.
(4) Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the voltage normal?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : Go to Step 6.
STEP 6. Check harness for short circuit to ground, open 
circuit or damage between PCM connector C-57 <2.4L 
Engine> or C-59 <3.0L Engine> terminal 75 and auto-cruise 
control-ECU connector C-20 terminal 3.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 7.
NO : Repair it.
